checks.name: Places start off and require explicit enable plus a stationary minute
Stale, inaccurate, moving, invalid and future fixes are rejected
Movement resets dwell rather than building a route
Manual save stores a rounded area and at most three distinct notes
First-visit save does not immediately replay place notes
Observed departure and stationary return recalls at most two notes
Nearby borderline or inaccurate position cannot match merely through a large accuracy circle
Location off or stale excludes place context immediately
Reload restores anchors without enabling tracking or leaking notes
Five-place limit prevents unbounded growth without silently evicting places
AI needs current verbatim learner evidence and an unchanged visit ticket
Automatic saves are limited to two per rolling day and one per stay
Forget blocks in-flight saves; another learner starts empty
Expired anchors are excluded and a later session needs fresh dwell
Coordinates and recognized credentials cannot be stored in labels or notes
History and summaries from a recalled place do not enter a different-place request
